title: Selenium metabolism-related genedrives tumor progression and microenvironment remodeling in oral squamous cell carcinoma.
snippet: Selenium metabolism is implicated in redox regulation and tumor progression, yet its role in oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) remains elusive. Thioredoxin reductase 1 (TXNRD1), a core selenoprotein, has been linked to malignant phenotypes, but its clinical relevance and biological functions in OSCC require further elucidation. title: Multi-omics integration identifies PON2 as a prognostic biomarker and mediator of tumor microenvironment remodeling in gallbladder cancer.
snippet: Gallbladder cancer (GBC) is an aggressive biliary tract malignancy with limited therapeutic options and poor prognosis. title: MIF-mediated intercellular crosstalk drives antigen-presenting-like cancer-associated fibroblast differentiation in triple-negative breast cancer via TGF-β signaling.
snippet: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is characterized by an aggressive tumor microenvironment (TME) in which cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) play a pivotal role. title: Multi-omics analysis of GBP2 as a prognostic and immune-associated biomarker in papillary thyroid carcinoma.
snippet: Guanylate-binding protein 2 (GBP2) is dysregulated in several malignancies and participates in immune regulation. title: Multifocal ground-glass opacities in lung cancer: a narrative review of genomic evolution, immune ecology, and biology-informed clinical management.
snippet: Ground-glass opacity (GGO) is a computed tomography descriptor rather than a histologic diagnosis.
